options.name: enabled
options.description: Indicates whether this remote is enabled.

options.name: executable
options.description: The path to the C(flatpak) executable to use. By default, this module looks for the C(flatpak) executable on the path.

options.name: flatpakrepo_url
options.description: The URL to the C(flatpakrepo) file representing the repository remote to add. When used with O(state=present), the flatpak remote specified under the O(flatpakrepo_url) is added using the specified installation O(method). When used with O(state=absent), this is not required. Required when O(state=present).

options.name: method
options.description: The installation method to use. Defines if the C(flatpak) is supposed to be installed globally for the whole V(system) or only for the current V(user).

options.name: name
options.description: The desired name for the flatpak remote to be registered under on the managed host. When used with O(state=present), the remote is added to the managed host under the specified O(name). When used with O(state=absent) the remote with that name is removed.
